name: Impersonation
description: Impersonation is the live execution of a pretext — presenting yourself as someone you are not in a way convincing enough to gain access, extract information, or manipulate behavior. Effective impersonation requires more than a costume: it demands appropriate body language, familiarity with the role you are playing, plausible props, and the confidence to hold the persona under pressure. High-value roles include HVAC technicians, IT support staff, fire safety inspectors, delivery drivers, and cleaning crews — roles that have legitimate reasons to access restricted areas and are rarely challenged.

blue.det: Security staff challenge reveals inconsistency in story or credentials; visitor log discrepancy; camera footage shows unknown individual in restricted area without escort.
blue.cm: Two-factor physical verification; visitor escort policy; security awareness training on credential verification; mantrap vestibules; challenge culture.
